{{Quote|A favorite on Naboo and throughout the Chommell sector, slow-cooked in our gamma flux broiler with space-carrots, Ojomian onions, Anzati snot garlic and Deltron spice wine. When I cooked chow for a militia camp in the Lesser Plooriod Cluster, shaak pot roast was always very popular. I suppose it reminded lonely soldiers of the warmth of a good, home-cooked meal. Or maybe it was just better than the cans of Skakoan processed, additive-enhanced meat I served most other nights.|Dex's Diner on its shaak pot roast|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Shaak pot roast''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] made from roasted meat of a [[Shaak/Legends|shaak]],<ref name="Menu" /> a type of herd [[Species/Legends|animal]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="Wildlife field guide">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> A favorite throughout the Chommell [[Sector/Legends|sector]], the shaak meat was slow-cooked in a [[gamma flux broiler]] along with  with [[Carrot/Legends|space-carrots]], [[Ojomian onion]]s, [[Anzati snot garlic]] and [[Deltron spice wine]].<ref name="Menu" />

At some point no later than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]],<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref>  the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] served shaak pot roast while cooking for a militia camp located the Mid Rim [[Lesser Plooriod Cluster/Legends|Lesser Plooriod Cluster]]. Jettster found that the pot roast was popular among the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. He later thought the dish must have reminded the soldiers of a home-cooked meal or that it was at least better than the [[Skakoan processed, additive-enhanced meat]] that he served most nights at the camp.<ref name="Menu" /> Later on, at a point no earlier than 28 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="DexDates" /> Jettster sold the dish for 8.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] at his [[Dex's Diner/Legends|diner]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="Menu" /> located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shaak pot roast was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
